title: Machine learning-based quantitative pathology reveals intratumoral heterogeneity in ductal carcinoma in situ and predicts invasive upstaging.
summary: Quantitative pathology models measured nuclear/architectural heterogeneity in DCIS and found biopsy heterogeneity informative for invasive upstaging, with internal and independent-cohort validation.
ai_technology: Methods describe single-cell morphometry, integrated grading and surgical-upstaging cohorts; Results report external grading performance and biopsy heterogeneity associated with later invasive upstaging.
